content.short: Mars Race connects players to the Mars4 Web3 game world, with Martian survival gameplay, NFTs, and play-to-earn loops.
content.description: Mars Race points to the Mars4 ecosystem, a Web3 game set on Mars with multiplayer survival gameplay, land and vehicle NFTs, staking, and play-to-earn progression. Its content is game-first: players enter a Mars metaverse rather than a finance dashboard. Mars4 is a project based on blockchain that allows users to earn passive income through revenue-generating NFTs and play-to-earn Mars Metaverse game. Important product areas are stake $shoot for exclusive warrior nfts, mars battle live on epic store, karkanda sentry is now live, and the first-ever multiplayer web3 game on mars.
